mainEntity.name: How often should I update AI competitor research?

acceptedAnswer.text: Use a repeatable monitoring workflow when competitor changes can affect your decisions, such as pricing, offers, product updates, messaging, or customer complaints. Website-change alerts and specialized tools can track selected pages, while broader platforms may cover search, traffic, advertising, reviews, or social activity. Key factors include: - which changes matter - monitoring frequency - source coverage - who will act on alerts. A specialized assistant can prepare a recurring brief, but an owner should decide whether a change requires a response. Do not monitor everything; define thresholds that connect alerts to business decisions.
acceptedAnswer.description: Update foundational research when your offer, audience, or market changes, and monitor selected signals on a recurring schedule when changes affect decisions. Track only meaningful items such as pricing, product updates, positioning, reviews, or channel activity, then assign someone to interpret alerts.
